title: Brass bands: Tuxedo, Onward and Manuel Perez
summary: Zardis followed brass bands like Tuxedo and Onward, recalls Perez as a sweet trumpeter he never played with because of loyalty to Petit, and Billy Marrero as manager.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I was asking more about your early life, the bands you heard, any brass bands, parades much you heard?

Yeah, I heard lots of brass bands. I used to follow the brass bands, such as Tuxedo Brass Band. They had a nice brass band. Yeah, that tuxedo was good. You ever heard of it before? Oh yes, that's the original. Yeah, they were good. And I tell you another band I heard, that Onward brass band.
Do you remember who all was in that?
No, so long I forget them fellas. I know Lois Dumain, he was one, he used to play with those boys.
Somebody told me Manuel Perez was playing with the Onward too. How did he sound?

Manuel? I was a sweet trumpet player. Did you ever play with him? No, I didn't play with, every time that Manuel had wanted me, looked like that same boy that would be all you know. And he'd tell me, he'd say, boy I'd like to get you to play in my band. He'd say, but by the time you turn around you're playing with Buddy. So I told him, I said, well you know how it is when you started up with a bunch. I said, you like to be with them, you know what I mean?
So he said, well yeah you're right.

He said, well I never did play with Manuel. But Manuel was a man though. He was a man. Now this Manuel I was telling you about Billy, Manuel was playing with Billy a long time. You see? Because Billy was the manager of the band. See in them times they'd take them fellas, they used to wear them caps, I don't know if you remember.

Captioning them coats, they would tape down the legs, you know what I mean? There was one with the Superior band, the same place where Billy was manager of that I think. Yeah, yeah. Well he was manager of that same band, the Erika band. That's the Erika. That's the other band I was telling you about. Onward? The Onward band, yeah.
